analysis.title: Weekly Fund Flows: EM Local Currency Outflows
key_insights: Global equity funds took in +$67bn in the week ending November 18, down from +$98bn the prior week. The four-week sum is $310bn, a z-score of 4.49.
DM equity inflows were driven mainly by US funds, which took in $45.6bn in the week and $155.8bn over four weeks. EM equity funds also saw inflows, led by Taiwan and Global EM Benchmark funds.
Global fixed income funds turned negative, with -$8.4bn in the week against +$0.3bn the prior week. Long-duration and short-duration bond funds both saw inflows, while EM bond funds saw outflows.
EM local-currency bond funds lost $6.1bn in the week (z-score -2.14 on the four-week sum) and have seen outsized outflows in recent weeks. EM hard-currency funds lost $1.6bn.

Sector fund flows were led by technology (+$8.1bn in the week, +$44.9bn over four weeks). Real estate and telecom also saw inflows in the week, while other sector funds saw outflows. Industrials had the largest weekly outflow at -$2.9bn, then financials at -$3.0bn and energy at -$1.6bn.
Mainland China equity funds took in $64.2bn over four weeks, but only $1.9bn in the latest week. Most of the four-week total came in the weeks ending October 28 and November 4 ($25.7bn and $34.5bn).
Japan equity funds saw -$4.2bn in the latest week, after +$4.2bn the week before. Korea funds saw -$0.5bn after +$4.0bn. Taiwan funds took in $4.9bn, a four-week z-score of 4.16.
Money market fund assets rose $0.3bn in the week after falling $17.9bn the prior week. The four-week sum is +$126bn.
Cross-border FX flows were positive at +$24.5bn in the week. USD, EUR and JPY saw the strongest net demand (+$12.3bn, +$2.3bn and +$2.5bn).

macro_indicators.interpretation: Inflows slowed from +$98bn the prior week but remain positive, led by US funds.
Flows turned negative, driven by EM bond fund outflows.
Outflows are outsized relative to history, with a four-week z-score of -2.14.
Net demand for USD, EUR and JPY was strongest.

charts_described: Chart of the Week plots four-week moving average flows into EM local and hard currency bond funds. The text states local currency bond funds have seen outsized outflows in recent weeks.
vol_and_positioning: Global equity fund inflows are +$310bn over four weeks, a z-score of 4.49.
High-beta sector funds (commodity, financial and industrial) saw -$4.7bn in the week. Low-beta sector funds saw -$0.5bn.
Technology funds have taken in $44.9bn over four weeks, with a z-score of 2.02.
